title: $1,000 in Visa in 2008 is now worth this
caption:
In 2008, Visa was listing in a crisis.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:V:2008-03-19} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Visa in 2008? 👇
sources: Visa price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2008, Visa was listing in a crisis.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:V:2008-03-19}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
